conversation.text: Wat? Nee, deze is van mij. Waarom denkt u dat het uw telefoon is?
conversation.translation: What? No, this one is mine. Why do you think it's your phone?

conversation.text: Dezelfde kleur, hetzelfde hoesje. Ik ben hem net verloren.
conversation.translation: Same color, same case. I just lost it.

conversation.text: Maar kijk, mijn foto staat op het scherm.
conversation.translation: But look, my photo is on the screen.

conversation.text: Oh, dan is die inderdaad van u.
conversation.translation: Oh, then it is indeed yours.

conversation.text: Misschien moeten we uw telefoon even bellen.
conversation.translation: Maybe we should call your phone.

conversation.text: Goed idee. Momentje, ik hoor hem.
conversation.translation: Good idea. One moment, I can hear it.
Where is the sound coming from?
